Second, the estimate-cut risk is priced differently in the two names: AMAT needs its 30.5x trailing multiple defended on a cycle that may be rolling, while NVDA at 26.6x trailing needs only the growth already reported to persist for one more quarter. The de-rating from 34.7x at the 120-day high to 26.6x has already done the work the cuts would do.
